_doc: Point-in-time fact sheet for F retrospectives (retro/build_f.py). Every value is tied to a source and becomes visible only on or after that source's 'published' date: a filing accepted after the 16:00 ET close is dated the next trading day ('filed' keeps the acceptance time, US Eastern). Ford's earnings 8-Ks of 2021-2026 were accepted after the close (16:07-16:14 ET) and its 10-Qs and 10-Ks the same evenings, so a print, its 10-Q or 10-K, and a Q4 print's 10-K share one date. Generated by a script from row strings of the filings (each checked with retro/tools/verbatim.py); every growth rate, margin change and rule-T value is computed. See retro/README.md, 'F'. The early era (dates before 2022-01-01, retro/README.md 'F 2008-2011') has its own records: the Q4 releases of 2001-2006 for the EPS history, the 10-Ks of FY2000-FY2013 (and the FY2005 10-K/A), the earnings releases of Q2 2007 to Q3 2014 (accepted before the open; a Q4 print carries its year's actuals, fy_actual, until the 10-K), the 2011-12-08 dividend 8-K, and rule_t_r2008 (the 1997-2006 decade). The 2015-2018 records (retro/README.md 'F 2015-2018') add the Q4 2014 to Q3 2018 releases (from Q4 2017 accepted after the close, so dated the next trading day; values a release prints only in an image are read from it and checked against a text filing, each named in the print's basis_note), the FY2014-FY2017 10-Ks, restatements_r2008 (a later filing's figure for an earlier year: the Q4 2014 release's 2013, the 8-K of 2016-01-07's 2013 and 2014 on mark-to-market pension accounting) and eps_guides_r2008 (fiscal-year adjusted EPS guides from the Q2 2017 release, and the preliminary 2017 figure).
